linkedin.text:
🏆 What's actually worth adding to your AI coding agent right now?

There are thousands of repos promising to make your agent smarter, faster or cheaper to run. Most aren't worth your time.

Here are five that are, ranked by stars:

✅ #5 HyperFrames (HeyGen) - write HTML, CSS and media, your agent turns it into deterministic MP4 video
✅ #4 CodeGraph - a pre-indexed knowledge graph of your codebase so agents make fewer tool calls
✅ #3 OmniRoute - a free gateway with one endpoint to 375+ providers and over 1,400 models
✅ #2 gstack - Garry Tan's Claude Code setup with virtual CEO, designer and QA roles, no salaries
✅ #1 ECC - a coding-agent harness with skills, memory and security features

ECC leads the pack at 292K stars.

Which one are you adding to your stack first? 👇
